    Uniqueness of exceptional contours #

    An exceptional dumb-bell contour is the only exceptional contour (db_unique). Two Q₂' contours at the same point agree (q2_same), and the twisted arrow of a Q₂' contour is not an arrow of a Q₂' contour at another point (q2_apart).
